justification: Three live API routes: /api/health always 503 (write test on read-only Vercel disk) -> read-only check; /api/versions?action=statistics (500, no caller) and /api/setbacks/calculate (throws, callers only in unmounted components) deleted.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: /api/health still returns 503 on a healthy deploy
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 2026-10-28 plan notes: /api/health always 503 on Vercel; checkFileSystem wrote .health-check into process.cwd().

pre_impl.existing_data: Callers traced 2026-10-28: /api/health used by Dockerfile liveness and scripts/smoke_test.sh; action=statistics has no caller; /api/setbacks/calculate called only by useSetbackCalculation/useSetbacks, whose components (PreciseSetbackCalculator, EnhancedSetbackVerification) are not mounted (docs/page_integrity/PRODUCER_MAP.md:439).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The health check assumed a writable working directory.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Edits existing routes; deletes one route file and one action.

functions.name: checkFileSystem
functions.input: no arguments; it reads the process working directory
functions.output: pass when the working directory is readable, else fail with the error message
functions.if_none: a missing directory fails the check with its error, visibly

values.if_missing: fs.access throws and the check reports fail

break_it.scenario: An unmounted component is later mounted and calls /api/setbacks/calculate.
break_it.what_happens: It gets a 404 instead of the previous crash.
break_it.how: The route already threw on every call; a 404 is no worse. Re-add it fixed if the calculator is revived.

break_it.scenario: An outside caller requests the versions statistics action.
break_it.what_happens: It gets a 400 listing valid actions instead of a 500.
break_it.how: No caller found in app, components, hooks, lib, workflows or scripts.

break_it.scenario: The deployed working directory becomes unreadable at runtime.
break_it.what_happens: The health route must report the file system as failing.
break_it.how: fs.access with R_OK throws and the check fails.
